headline_stat.name: POST-sleep SWRs with significant trajectory (vs PRE), Fisher p

stated_limitation: Both forward and reverse trajectories occur (23 vs 18 of the significant POST events; not significantly biased in this session).

justification.dataset: 000044 Achilles CA1 linear-track sleep/maze/sleep is the canonical hippocampal replay dataset.
justification.handling: Real NWB streamed via remfile; excitatory units, explicit place-cell criteria, ripples restricted to Non-REM, correct alignment.
justification.analysis: Standard Bayesian decoding with posterior-weighted time-position correlation, per-event cell-ID shuffle null, and a PRE control calibrating the false-positive rate.
justification.correctness: Deterministic seeded pipeline; reported 41/211 vs 29/637 and Fisher/MW p-values trace to code, are internally consistent, and PRE's 4.6% confirms the 5% calibration.
justification.figures: Place fields tile the track, ripple detection and peri-SWR co-activation are clear, and decoded forward/reverse examples (correctly ranked by trajectory score) plus population panels show the effect with units and n.
justification.honesty: Claims are proportionate with good calibration language and a stated forward/reverse balance, but there is no explicit limitations section on this clean single-session result.
justification.verdict: A strong, reproducible, well-controlled replay demonstration I would accept from a rotation student.
